text: Indexing into a semantic_text field automatically generates and stores vector embeddings using a configured ML model
quote: When you index content into a `semantic_text` field, Elasticsearch automatically generates vector embeddings using a configured machine learning model and stores them in the underlying vector field.

text: Semantic search setup needs only an index mapping, with no model settings or inference ingest pipelines to configure
quote: All you need to do is create an index mapping to start ingesting, embedding, and querying data. There is no need to define model-related settings and parameters, or to create inference ingest pipelines.

text: Supports external or hosted embedding models, or your own pre-computed vectors
quote: You can deploy external or hosted embedding models, or bring your own pre-computed vectors.

text: ML models can be deployed and run directly inside Elasticsearch
quote: Option 3: Deploy models directly in Elasticsearch

text: Inference API workflow gives finer control over how inference endpoints are configured
quote: The inference API workflow is more complex but offers greater control over the inference endpoint configuration.

text: Hybrid search runs full-text and vector search in one request and returns a single combined ranked list
quote: Hybrid search runs full-text search and vector search in one request... you return one ranked list that combines keyword matching with similarity search.

text: Hybrid results can be merged with reciprocal rank fusion (RRF) across full-text and vector rankings
quote: We recommend implementing hybrid search with the reciprocal rank fusion (RRF) algorithm. This approach merges rankings from the full-text and vector queries

text: Vector search can be combined with full-text search, structured filters, and aggregations in one engine
quote: Elasticsearch can combine vector search with full-text search, structured filters, aggregations, and hybrid retrieval in one engine

text: Acts as a vector database by storing embeddings in dense_vector or sparse_vector fields and querying them for similarity
quote: Elasticsearch functions as a vector database when you store embeddings in `dense_vector` or `sparse_vector` fields and query them for similarity.

text: Offers reranking and GPU inference through the same API as vector and hybrid search
quote: Vector and hybrid search, reranking, and GPU inference in one API. Build fast, relevant AI apps and agents on context you can trust.

text: Can serve as the retrieval layer for RAG systems
quote: RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) systems

text: Vector quantization calibration is sped up during index merges

text: Quickstart lets you create a project, index data, and run semantic and hybrid searches in about 10 minutes

text: Official client libraries and developer tools are available for most popular programming languages
quote: Elasticsearch is easy to use from most popular programming languages, thanks to the wide range of official libraries and developer tools available.

text: Official skills teach AI coding agents how to work with Elasticsearch, Kibana, Fleet, and the Elastic stack

text: Forward compatibility policy keeps client applications working with a newer server before the client is upgraded

text: Supports multiple query languages, including Query DSL, ES|QL, and KQL
quote: Browse the docs for Query DSL, ES|QL, KQL, and more.

text: Deployable anywhere, including on-prem or in private or public cloud, with both self-managed and Elastic-managed options
quote: Deploy anywhere: on-prem or in private or public cloud

text: Serverless projects are fully managed, with no cluster management, infrastructure management, or upgrades
quote: run Elasticsearch, Vector Database, Observability, and Security as fully managed serverless projects - no cluster management, no need to manage underlying infrastructure, no upgrades

text: Serverless automatically provisions and scales resources with actual usage, including short-term ingest spikes
quote: when you have a short-term spike on the data you ingest, more resources are allocated for that period of time. When the spike is over, the system uses less resources, without any action on your end.

text: Separate search and index tiers can be scaled independently on hardware optimized for each
quote: Separating search and index tiers enables workloads to be scaled independently and reliably, with optimized hardware for each use case.

text: Free 14-day trial is available for new users to create a serverless project
